item.title: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?

item.title: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
item.description: Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.

item.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
item.description: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.
